# Vendored libraries

Served from this site so no third-party CDN sees who plays.

- `supabase.min.js`: [supabase-js](https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js) 2.118.0, MIT licence, Copyright (c) 2020 Supabase. Bundled with esbuild from `export { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'` as an IIFE with the global `supabase`.
- `qrcode.js`: [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) 2.0.4, MIT licence, Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase. Unmodified `dist/qrcode.js`.
